units.source_text: 你羞澀的微笑，是前途無量的藝術家特有的表情。

en.t: Your shy smile is the expression peculiar to an artist with a brilliant future.

units.source_text: 為了紀念我們倆的相識，乾杯！

en.t: To commemorate the two of us getting acquainted, cheers!

units.source_text: 小娟，這小子是美男子吧？

en.t: Kinu, this fellow is a handsome man, isn't he?
You mustn't fall for him, now.

units.source_text: 這小子來到繪畫教室後，遺憾的是，我淪為了第二號美男子。」

en.t: After this fellow came to the painting class, unfortunately I was reduced to the number two handsome man.

units.source_text: 堀木膚色黝黑，五官端正。

en.t: Horiki had a dark complexion and regular, handsome features.

units.source_text: 著一身板正的西裝，繫著素雅的領帶，頭髮抹了髮油，留了箇中分頭，在繪畫教室的學生中，這樣的打扮是很少見的。

en.t: He wore a proper suit, a subdued necktie, pomade in his hair, and a center part; among the students at the painting class, such dress was rare.

units.source_text: 置身於陌生的環境，心中略顯緊張。

en.t: Being in unfamiliar surroundings, I felt a little tense inside.

units.source_text: 一會兒盤著胳膊，一會兒又鬆開，始終面帶羞澀的微笑。

en.t: I kept crossing my arms and then uncrossing them, all the while wearing a shy smile.

units.source_text: 喝下兩三杯酒後，卻格外有一種像被解放的輕鬆感。

en.t: After drinking two or three cups, however, I felt an oddly liberated lightness.
